# Q-051 E1: a_usd_deposit_and_its_fee_on_a_holding_account.txt as the owner
# books it once they know the deposit was the customer paying INV-USD-1.
#
# The holding-account amount is the receivable settling the invoice, at the
# 3,791.14 it was posted at; the 1.01 is the bank charge; the fee's 0.72 comes
# out of the invoice's cost basis, `{invoice_posting}` in this file, which the
# test fills in with that split's guid, valued at what it costs, 1.00. The one
# `$residual$` split states what the collection and the fee realize, -24.76.
# Imported with `--strategy update`, beside INV-USD-1's `payment:` block
# stating this transaction and its receivable split.
#
# The new shape is the invoice's collection, which establishes no cost basis:
# the dollars' cost is the invoice's.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_statement_line_on_a_holding_account_is_edited_into_what_it_settles.py.
